svg.aria-label: sage-bot: ask sage from your team's Discord. Mention @sage-bot, and each mention opens its own thread. The flow: Discord, your server, sends an ask to sage-bot on the owner's Mac, which reads sage's logbook. Two roles: sage-apprentice reads and asks; sage-lead also decides and stops. Discord is a trademark of Discord Inc. sage-bot is not affiliated with Discord.
